dimensions.note: No credential or secret handling. Global args are repo-relative paths and a boolean; no vault refs needed.
Structured placeholders throughout ('Scanned {files} file(s) ...', 'Checked {n} pulled extension(s) ...', 'Scan complete: {e} error(s), {w} warning(s)'). No interpolation and no sensitive data.

checkExtensions builds missingFiles by re-testing each file it just walked (the loop at the end of the function is a no-op, since walk only yields existing files); only a wholly absent files/ directory is detected. Also findHardcodedPaths silently skips unreadable files. Both are pre-existing and non-blocking — the meaningful integrity signal (files/ absent) still fires.

New repo_doctor_test.ts covers relative(), offendingLines() (hit and no-hit), isCovered() (exact/prefix/parent, comments, negation), and renderReport() (healthy/empty and grouped-by-severity). The filesystem-walking methods are not unit-tested, but their pure logic is.
Read-only checks; reruns are idempotent. scan() writes all five outputs in one pass, so a failure throws before a partial report is exposed.
No external HTTP or network calls; only local filesystem reads.
Uses Deno.readDir/readFile/stat only; every handle is closed by the runtime on return. No temp files or connections.

README uses generic paths (.swamp/..., extensions/models) and no real hostnames or account identifiers. Test fixtures use placeholder usernames (/home/alice, /home/maphew) as non-portable-path examples.
All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); CEL validation works.
Every resource and the report file set lifetime 7d and garbageCollection 10, appropriate for a periodic health snapshot.
Not a CRUD lifecycle model — it is an analysis scanner with no create/update/delete surface.
No mutating methods, so no pre-flight gate is required.
scan() writes scan-current, paths-current, extensions-current, gitignore-current, report-current — unique per spec and consistent across the single- and multi-check methods.
Stateless; reads no stored resources and uses no dataRepository access.
Bumped to 2026.10.14.1 and added a no-op upgrades entry (source moved to swamp-extensions; no schema changes) so existing instances advance their typeVersion.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — FindingSchema has 6 fields (check, severity, file, line, message, detail); every finding push sets all 6. ScanReportSchema has 5 fields and scan() writes all 5. Paths/Extensions/Gitignore reports each match their write sites.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: na — no paginated or result-capped method.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — each spec has exactly one writer instance name (scan-current, paths-current, extensions-current, gitignore-current) plus the report file report-current.
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — every declared field is written on the code path that produces the resource; no placeholders.
